items.title: 30.4.3 D2O exchange se O-H aur N-H protons pehchanna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of identifying O-H and N-H protons (PDF 209).

blocks.text: O-H groups (alcohols, carboxylic acids) aur N-H groups (amines, amides) ke hydrogen atoms molecules ke darmiyan aasani se badalte hain, is liye in ki singlet peaks chemical shifts ki wasee had dikhati aur pehchanna mushkil ho sakta hai. 'Deuterium exchange', ya 'D2O shake', kehlane wala tareeqa dikhata hai ke koi singlet O-H ya N-H hydrogen ki wajah se hai ya nahi. Pehle compound ka 1H NMR spectrum liya jata hai, jo O-H ya N-H samet us ke tamam H atoms dikhata hai. Phir sample tube mein D2O ke chand qatre dal kar mehlool achhi tarah hilaya aur spectrum dobara liya jata hai. Doosre spectrum mein O-H ya N-H peak ghaib ho jati hai; dono spectra ka muqabla use pehchanta hai.

Wajah yeh hai ke O ya N jaise bohat electronegative atoms se jure protons aasani se badalte hain: D2O milane par yeh hydrogens jaldi deuterium atoms se badal jate hain, R-O-H + D2O <=> R-O-D + HOD. Deuterium ko spin palatne ke liye mukhtalif tawanai chahiye, is liye yeh 1H spectrum mein peak nahi deta aur 'ghaib' ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do spectra, delta 7 se 0. Oopar: ethanol ka spectrum, taqreeban 5.4 par O-H ki akeli peak, 3.6 par quartet aur 1.2 par triplet. Neeche: D2O shake ke baad wahi spectrum, lekin O-H wali peak ghaib hai; quartet aur triplet waise hi hain.
blocks.caption: D2O shake: pehle aur baad ka spectrum (is topic ke liye hamara asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: D2O shake ke baad O-H ya N-H peaks kyun ghaib ho jati hain?
blocks.explanation: O-H ya N-H hydrogens deuterium se badalte hain (R-O-H + D2O <=> R-O-D + HOD); deuterium mukhtalif frequency par jazb karta, is liye 1H signal nahi deta.

blocks.prompt: -CH2CH2NH2 group ke liye mutawaqqa peak areas aur batne ke namoone batayein.
blocks.explanation: Teen signals, areas 2:2:2. NH2 ke saath wala CH2 triplet (parosi CH2 par 2 H); NH2 aam taur par chauri singlet (aur D2O se ghaib); doosra CH2 kam az kam triplet, aur zyada agar molecule ke baqi hisse mein us ke doosre parosi par H ho.

items: O-H aur N-H protons D2O se badal kar signals ghaib.
R-O-H + D2O <=> R-O-D + HOD; deuterium 1H signal nahi deta.
